title: Release train tactical: week 2025-11-03 notes
content:
Attendees: Jordan (note), Ava, Riley, Samir, Priya, on-call SRE (Lina), + product (Marcos) 

Context / goal for the week: quick triage of hotfix queue, finalize canary cadence for the v1.14 train, decide deploy window for dataset-serving change that impacts KV cache warming. We want to keep the risk surface tight while making progress on throughput improvements.

Top-level summary:
- Hotfix queue trimmed from 9 -> 4 items (priority: sev2/3). Two fixes are blocked on test infra flakiness; one is ready for staging deploy; one needs patch review.
- Canary cadence agreed: 5% traffic for 30 minutes, 20% for 1 hour, full rollout if no errors and error-rate delta < 0.2% vs baseline. Canary to use geo-routing to us-west-2 only.
- Dataset-serving KV warming change postponed from Tue night to Fri morning due to overlap with infra maintenance window.
- Rollback plan standardized: immediate return to previous model variant + disable persistent cache; automated rollback script tested in sandbox.

Meeting notes (chronological):
1) Hotfix triage (Jordan)
  - RINF-4821 (text-generation: fallback loop on long prompt): assigned to Samir; root cause likely cache invalidation race; staging patch applied; needs regression test. Blocker: flaky seq2seq tests (see ticket for test tags).
  - RINF-4873 (dedicated: pod OOM on backup flush): assigned to Riley; mitigation already shipped (limit flush concurrency) — monitor metrics. Lina to add OOM alert with runbook link.
  - RINF-4902 (console: deploy UI crash for large route sets): low priority; owners: product/frontend; deferred.
  - RINF-4910 (embedder: slow cold-start for small batch sizes): in-progress, PR open (#2198). Priya to validate with quantized model profile.

Actions:
  - Samir: write regression test case for RINF-4821 by Thu (Jira link in linked_artifacts).
  - Riley & Lina: add OOM alert and create dashboard tile for flush latency, due Fri EOD.
  - Priya: run perf matrix for PR #2198 against 2/4/8 batch sizes; share raw CSV in thread.

2) Canary cadence & rollout policy (Ava)
  - Proposal: new canary policy for v1.14 that uses traffic-splitper and healthcheck thresholds. Decided safe params: 5% x 30m, 20% x 60m. If 5xx rate increases by >0.1% trigger automatic rollback.
  - Special-case for embeddings endpoints: slower metrics, so require 60m observation at 20% before 100%.
  - Need to document policy in Confluence (action: Jordan).

3) Dataset-serving KV warming change (Priya)
  - Change: introduce background warming job on deploy to prime KV cache for expected prefixes. Expected to reduce tail latency on first-user requests.
  - Risk: additional IO during deploy; coincides with infra maintenance Tue night -> moved to Fri morning 02:00 PST.
  - Safety: run warming in controlled rate limit (10 ops/s) and abort if average latency > 2s for 3 consecutive minutes. Lina to add guard in deploy pipeline.

4) Rollback and automated recovery (Riley)
  - Walkthrough of rollback play: switch traffic to previous model variant, clear persistent cache (optional), trigger DB flag to disable new routing rules. Script tested in sandbox and validated end-to-end (time to rollback ~2.5m).
  - Pending improvement: include automated post-rollback notification to #release-ops and open a ticket linking logs.

5) Infra & capacity notes (Lina)
  - We are at 78% reserve utilization on dedicated pools for peak hours. If v1.14 increases throughput by 8% we need to prep a small autoscale bump (add 2 nodes to us-west-2 dedicated pool). Action: platform-eng to approve by Thu EOD.
  - Spike observed in token throughput on Wed 2025-10-29 (traced to long-running batch jobs). Proposal to add circuit breaker for heavyweight jobs during deploy windows.

Risks & open questions:
- Test infra flakiness (seq2seq) blocking RINF-4821 verification. Who owns flaky-test mitigation? (action: test-platform to triage, assigned to DevEx).
- Slack thread debate about canary thresholds for embeddings — product to confirm risk tolerance. Marcos to weigh in by Wed.
- Does warming job require separate billing metering? Finance flagged potential cost bump for large customers. Need cost estimate from Priya.

Decisions made:
- Canary cadence parameters (see above) approved for this train.
- KV warming moved to Fri 02:00 PST to avoid maintenance overlap.
- Rollback script to be included in release checklist and tested each train.

Parking lot (not for this week):
- Faster multi-tenancy routing (Q1 plan)
- Autoscaling policy rewrite for long-tail workloads
- Dedicated pool pre-warming for predicted churn windows

Action items (owner / due):
- Jordan: write/update Confluence page with canary/playbook and link to rollback script (due 2025-11-06).
- Samir: regression test for RINF-4821 (due 2025-11-05).
- Riley: OOM alert + dashboard tile (due 2025-11-07).
- Priya: perf matrix & cost estimate for warming job (due 2025-11-06).
- Lina: add deploy pipeline guard for warming job (due 2025-11-05).
- Platform-eng: decision on adding 2 nodes to us-west-2 dedicated pool (approve by 2025-11-06).

Notes to self / freeform:
- Need a short hand-rolled script to test canary escalation faster in staging; current emulation takes too long. Could reuse the smoke-test harness.
- Reminder: update the release checklist to include "verify warming job rate limit" checkbox.
- Ping legal about any billing impact for customers on private deployments if warming increases IO charges.

Meeting adjourned. Next sync: Mon 2025-11-10 09:00 PST (standup + triage).
